languages.bonus: Draconic, Dwarven, Elven, Giant, Goblin, Orc

traits.name: Defensive Training
traits.summary: Gain +4 dodge AC against monsters of the giant subtype.

traits.name: Gnome Magic
traits.summary: Increase illusion DCs by 1 and, with Charisma 11, gain the Core gnome spell-like abilities.

traits.name: Hatred
traits.summary: Gain +1 on attacks against humanoids of the reptilian and goblinoid subtypes.

traits.name: Illusion Resistance
traits.summary: Gain +2 on saves against illusion spells and effects.

traits.name: Low-Light Vision
traits.summary: See twice as far as humans in dim light.

traits.name: Obsessive
traits.summary: Gain +2 on one Craft or Profession skill.

traits.name: Weapon Familiarity
traits.summary: Treat weapons with gnome in their name as martial.

alternateTraits.name: Eternal Hope
alternateTraits.summary: Gain +2 on saves against fear and despair and once per day reroll a natural 1 on a d20.

alternateTraits.name: Gift of Tongues
alternateTraits.summary: Gain +1 Bluff and Diplomacy and learn an extra language whenever you gain a Linguistics rank.

alternateTraits.name: Magical Linguist
alternateTraits.summary: Improve language-dependent and magical-writing spell DCs, saves against them, and gain four language spell-like abilities.

alternateTraits.name: Master Tinker
alternateTraits.summary: Gain +1 Disable Device and Knowledge (engineering), and proficiency with weapons you personally craft.

alternateTraits.name: Pyromaniac
alternateTraits.summary: Count as one level higher for specified fire spells and powers and gain fire-themed spell-like abilities.

alternateTraits.name: Warden of Nature
alternateTraits.summary: Gain +2 dodge AC and +1 attacks against aberrations, oozes, and vermin.
